issue.title: test_crm.py: "crm_stats_acl_entry_used" counter was not decremented or "crm_stats_acl_entry_available" counter was not incremented on DNX devices

failure.body:
On DNX devices test_crm.py fails with the following assertion:
```
    pytest_assert(crm_stats_checker,
                  "\"crm_stats_acl_entry_used\" counter was not decremented or "
                  "\"crm_stats_acl_entry_available\" counter was not incremented")
```

This is because the ACL_ENTRY_AVAILABLE returned by DNX SAI is NULL (4095) when no rules are applied to an ACL.

This results in the total USED+AVAILABLE number being much higher when no rules are applied to an ACL vs a few rules applied to an ACL.

Broadcom CSP CS00012288540 is tracking this issue.

This is easily reproducible by adding rules to the ACL and removing rules from the ACL:
```
> scp templates/acl.json <switch>:/tmp/acl-0.json

# crm config polling interval 1

# acl-loader update full /tmp/acl-0.json

# crm show resources acl table

Table ID         Resource Name      Used Count    Available Count
---------------  ---------------  ------------  -----------------
0x7000000000c94  acl_entry                   2               2040
0x7000000000c94  acl_counter                 2                  2

# acl-loader delete

# crm show resources acl table

Table ID         Resource Name      Used Count    Available Count
---------------  ---------------  ------------  -----------------
0x7000000000c94  acl_entry                   0               4095
0x7000000000c94  acl_counter                 0                  0
```

resolution.title: Leave 1 ACL rule in test_crm.py::test_acl_entry
resolution.description:
Some platforms (like broadcom-dnx) allocate ACL banks dynamically so if there are no ACL rules it returns a NULL value for CRM purposes. So leave 1 ACL rule when comparing the returned used/available CRM values.

Also on broadcom-dnx an ACL entry is used per bind point so account for that when calculating the expected available acl entries.

Fixes #8812
